I farm 9 mu with my wife. Just us two. Children work in town, so I do most of the field work myself, hire a little help at harvest.

My land is wheat then maize, same as everyone in Quzhou. Been doing it 35 years. Last year wheat gave me about 450 kg per mu, maize close to 580. Not bad. I will do about the same this year, no reason to change much.

For wheat I use the compound fertilizer 15-15-15, two bags per mu at sowing in October. That is 100 jin, about 50 kg. Then when wheat wakes up in spring at jointing stage I top-dress with urea, about 30 jin per mu, maybe 15 kg. The dealer in town said urea is a bit cheaper this year so I will not cut back. Better to give the wheat enough than worry later. Water three times — once before winter to protect it, once at jointing with the urea, once when heads come out. If spring is dry I add one more.

For maize after wheat harvest in June, I do no-till direct seeding with the hired machine, saves time and the stubble keeps moisture. Hybrid seed Zhengdan or Xianyu, whatever the shop has. I put compound fertilizer in the row with the planter, about 40 kg per mu, then urea top-dress at knee-high stage, maybe 20 kg. Maize eats more than wheat, I learned this from my neighbor Old Wang who tried to save money and his maize was yellow.

Pesticide — wheat I spray twice, once for aphids and once mixed with herbicide. Maize I spray once or twice for borer. I don't like to spray extra, costs money and I breathe it.

Seeds I buy improved wheat from the agri-station, hybrid maize from the shop. Not traditional, nobody here uses old seed anymore.
